videos.title: Samsung Electronics Union Begins Voting on Agreement Today... "Let's Join Forces" (05/22/2026/New...
videos.subtitle_summary: Samsung Electronics Union is holding a vote on a tentative agreement for performance bonuses from May 22nd to 5th. The majority of the union members, who are predominantly from the semiconductor division, are expected to approve it. The key points include maintaining the existing performance bonus system and introducing special management performance bonuses only for semiconductor employees. A portion of the success-based profits (10.5%) will be used as funds, which will be provided in Samsung Electronics stocks instead of cash. This new system will be applied for 10 years, with a condition that it will only be implemented if the company achieves an operating profit of 200 billion won or more for three consecutive years starting from next year. Loss-making departments will continue to receive full payments this year but may see reduced payouts starting next year. The performance bonus discussion excluded other divisions such as smartphones and appliances, who will instead receive Samsung Electronics stocks worth 600 million won each. Although there are protests against the agreement from some DX division members, it is expected to be approved due to the overwhelming majority of semiconductor union members (78,000). The top management has already announced organizational changes in response to this unified stance among employees. The head of the semiconductor department, Vice Chairman Jeon Yeong-hyeon, emphasized that it's important to move forward by putting aside disagreements and working together as one. MBC News, Lee Ju-seo.

videos.title: Samsung Electronics Avoids Worst-Case Scenario… Union Vote Remains (05/21/2026/12 MBC News)
videos.subtitle_summary:

2. 최근 30년 만기 미국의 금리가 5.2%까지 취소되었으나, 여전히 2007년 이후 가장 높은 수준을 유지하고 있습니다. 인플레이션 우료가 커지면서 투자자들이 국가가 발행한 채권을 좀 팔고, 이젠 선호하지 않는다는 의미입니다.
3. 오늘 코스피는 4.28% 오르며, 특히 삼성전자와 SK 하이닉스가 증시 상승을 입었습니다.

videos.title: 엔비디아, 12분기 연속 매출 신기록 세우며 뉴욕 증시 '캐리'...기대주 오픈AI 곧 등판 / YTN
videos.subtitle_summary:
1. NVIDIA, 전년 85% 증가를 보여 816억 2천만 달러의 매출을 기록하며, 12분기 연속 최고 매출 신기록을 세우면서 뉴욕 증시가 상승합니다.
2. AI 업계의 기대주인 오픈AI는 9월 뉴욕 증시 상장을 목표로 IPO 신청서를 제출하고 있습니다.
3. NVIDIA의 강력한 실적은 관련 업종도 견인하는 파급력이 크며, 오픈AI가 상장을 추진하는 것은 자금 조달을 선점하기 위함으로 보입니다.

videos.title: [투자 노하우] 엔비디아 역대급 1분기 매출 신기록…AI호황?
videos.subtitle_summary:
1. 뉴욕 증시는 상승 마각했으며, 35%의 전체 세계 반환은 AI 13개 회사로부터 나왔습니다.
2. 지금의 시장에서 주목해야 할 것은 매크로 이슈와 관련된 부분입니다. 최근에는 미국 장기물에 대한 이슈가 가장 크게 되고 있습니다.
3. 일본 국채의 수익률이 상당히 민감하여, 일본이 금리를 올리면 미국체 장기물도 추가로 위험에 노출될 가능성이 있다는 것을 보고 있습니다.

videos.title: 엔비디아, 12분기 연속 매출 신기록 세우며 뉴욕 증시 '캐리'…기대주 오픈AI 곧 등판 [세상만사] #엔비디아 #매출신기록
videos.subtitle_summary:
1. NVIDIA, a global leader in AI semiconductors, set a new sales record in the 12th quarter with an 816 billion dollar revenue, surpassing market expectations by a significant margin. This has caused the New York Stock Exchange to rise due to increased optimism about NVIDIA's performance.
2. OpenAI, a highly anticipated AI industry player, is planning to go public on the New York Stock Exchange in September and submit its IPO application on the 20th. This move has attracted attention from the market.
3. The strong performance of NVIDIA has a significant impact on related industries such as lumens (similar to Samsung Electronics) and Broadcom, and is being highly evaluated. Meanwhile, OpenAI's decision to go public could be an attempt to secure funds ahead of SpaceX's expected NASDAQ listing and other upcoming IPOs.

videos.title: 브레이브스 vs. 말린스 하이라이트 (2026년 5월 20일) | MLB 하이라이트
videos.subtitle_summary:
1. The game (Game 3 of a 4-game series) between the Braves and Marlins is being played at Lone Depot Park in Miami, Florida, near the Mkasuki Canal.
2. Chris Sale, a 37-year-old pitcher, is making his 10th start of the season for the Marlins. He has never earned a win against the Braves or Cardinals.
3. Xavier Edwards, a problematic player for the Braves in this series, gets a leadoff single and advances to third base as Otto Lopez hits a line drive into center field.
